Functions $h$ and $g$ are graphed.

![Function h is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments and a closed circle. The set starts at (negative 4, 2), moves upward through an open circle at (3, 3) to (negative 2, 4), moves downward and ends at (4, negative 1). The closed circle is plotted at (negative 3, 0).](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/9e0778b6c175f38633c23179fa1bf57c2c5638d1) ![Function g is graphed. The x-axis goes from negative 4 to 4. The graph consists of a set of line segments. The set starts at (negative 4, 3), moves downward through (negative 3, 2) to (0, negative 1), moves upward to (1, 1), moves horizontally to the right and ends at (4, 1). ](web+graphie:${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/5eb915c6a848340b1f1c60150cde85b47ccb815d)

**Find $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to -3}\Big(h(x)+g(x)\Big)$.**
